A.label: A · Native resolution + standard VAE
A.description: The unchanged v0.6.0 baseline: native-resolution generation and standard H3 video VAE decoding. Original prepared references.

L.label: L · Low resolution + Lanczos
L.description: Generate at approximately half width and height, decode with the standard H3 video VAE, then enlarge with fixed Lanczos. Original prepared references.

C.label: C (= X) · Low resolution + X2 VAE
C.description: The frozen validation candidate is X: the same low-resolution latent as L, floating-point X2 decoding, original prepared references. B32, decoder quantization and streaming optimization are off.
